Players Committee card image of [[Mustafar]], errata card marked “E”, printing: Light Side: “If Vader on table, unless Amidala at a Mustafar location, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “While Anakin or Vader here, gains one [Dark Side] icon and one [Light Side] icon.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2f0f28b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/hires/mustafar.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/hires/mustafar.png] as of commit 2f0f28b “2021 March Errata” (18 March 2021).
